name: YMCA of Greenwich School-Aged Summer Camps
description_short: Weekday summer day camps for kids from age 3 through 10th grade, run at the YMCA of Greenwich and at Camp Seton in Greenwich. The options are a full-day general camp (Discovery Camp), an outdoor Adventure Camp, half-day camps that follow summer school, and short specialty camps for coding, entrepreneurship and diving.
swim_waterfront_notes: Discovery Camp includes swimming. Adventure Camp at Camp Seton includes canoeing and swimming. Dive clinics are held in the YMCA Olympic Pool on the 1-meter and 3-meter boards. The page does not give swim test or lifeguard details.

warnings: Today is 2026-10-13. All session dates on this page are for summer 2026, which is over. The page says '2027 REGISTRATION OPENS JAN 1, 2027!', but no 2027 dates, ages or prices are posted yet.
The page title says elementary school, but the programs range from age 3 (Discovery Camp Purple Team) up to 10th grade (Summer School Camp at Camp Seton). Dive clinics are open to all ages.
This page covers several separate programs at two locations: the YMCA at 50 East Putnam Ave and Camp Seton at 363 Riversville Rd, Greenwich, CT 06831.
Extended care at Adventure Camp is only for campers who take the bus. Jr. Innovator's Lab and Code Ninjas have no extended care.
Dive clinic end dates are the last clinic day. There are no clinics on Tuesdays.
